linework.observation: Clean strong contours define character, duffel, pier gear, submarine hull and dock building.

colour.observation: Muted navy, olive, cream and charcoal with natural blue sky; no neon or oversaturation.

shading.observation: Soft cel shadows model clothing and cases; hull and pier use simplified illustrated highlights.

character_construction.observation: Bald protagonist’s full face and body remain coherent.

backgrounds.observation: Submarine pier with solid dock building, cases, duffel and moored boat.

finish.observation: Crisp unified cartoon illustration without legible stray text or artifacts.

identity.observation: Protagonist is clearly bald and consistent with level-one costume.

content.observation: The character checks mail beside a duffel at the pier; no retirement folder or weapons appear.

composition.observation: Full-body wide view retains clear headroom and keeps mail and submarine in frame.

regions.people_faces: One bald protagonist listening on a handset while reading an envelope.
regions.architecture: Dock building and moored submarine; no torpedo stores.
regions.distance: Pier and boat recede behind the character, with clear illustrated contours.
regions.lighting: Natural daylight in muted blue and warm neutral tones.
